hypotheses: H1 challengers fail to reach feasible assignments
H2 native and positive evidence can lock wrong identities
H3 identity confidence is not global action value
H4 causal memory needs simultaneous safety and retention
fold_rule: H outer; next sequence cyclically inner; other six fit. No outer labels or metrics in training/selection.
adapter: Reuse R4 SHA-verified strict six-sequence Adapter ensemble. Never refit on inner or outer.
updater: Frozen SHA-verified N72R18 GRU; immutable anchor; explicit public/state binding.
formal_events: Reuse original R4 event per sequence, complete pre-click frames, same dynamic lifecycle, max_lost_gap=90.

training_events.anchor_rule: Earliest frame with a valid real candidate matched to that identity at IoU>=0.5; highest IoU then UID tie-break at that frame only. Anchor is that observed candidate feature/box, not a new GT candidate.
training_events.identity_selection: All eligible identities, no future-difficulty filtering; at least 31 future frames for supervision availability only.
training_events.sample_frames: Every twentieth frame after anchor, plus first five future frames; rule independent of GT correctness.
training_events.candidate_matching: Offline one-to-one IoU matching >=0.5, preserve unmatched real detections as competitors.
training_events.counterfactual_cache: Adapter-independent environment outcomes may be content-addressed and reused across folds; readers enforce sequence in the requesting six fit sequences. Heldout labels cannot select a model. Every candidate action is proposed without GT before labels.
training_events.anti_duplication: Unique (sequence, identity, frame, action, candidate_uid); no duplicated positives. Correct/harmful/neutral strata all retained.

forced_solver: Fix a legal target edge, remove its row and column, solve remaining complete candidate/public/NONE problem; reconstruct all ownership. REJECT removes target column. Never use a big additive weight as a fake forced edge.
hard_constraints: Explicit has_negative mask OR original <=-1e8 sentinel is immutable. Infeasible actions are recorded, not silently coerced.

runtime_proposals.family: Union of Adapter top-K, raw-anchor ReID top-K and original base target-column top-K real candidates; exclude KEEP edge; include REJECT. Family and K selected on inner only. No GT or future features.
runtime_proposals.ownership: Occupied candidates are GLOBAL_SWAP proposals; target NONE uses RECOVER; original baseline uses exact global solve.

counterfactual_supervision.first_tier: Execute H1/H5 for every legal candidate action at each deterministically sampled fit identity/frame; include KEEP, oracle and runtime flags separately.
counterfactual_supervision.second_tier: Deterministic SHA sampling of up to six positive, six harmful and six neutral/boundary H5 examples per identity; execute H10/H30 for all strata, no favorable-only reporting.
counterfactual_supervision.state: Clone full state BEFORE current action. Each branch scores/solves/commits its own future state, no baseline future tape injection.
counterfactual_supervision.public_truth: Posthoc stable baseline public-ID origins, clicked identity explicitly fixed from anchor preparation; no future-GT rebinding of treatment publics.
counterfactual_supervision.beneficial: Actual global assignment changed, value_H5>0, no immediate correct-to-wrong override.
counterfactual_supervision.harmful: value_H5<0 OR immediate correct-to-wrong override; raw other damage retained even when weighted value is positive.
counterfactual_supervision.neutral: Neither beneficial nor harmful; KEEP value is exactly zero.
counterfactual_supervision.oracle: GT-assisted TRAINING-only action identification, posthoc diagnostic, never online policy.
counterfactual_supervision.window_trackeval: Selected H30 event windows keep all GT identities and all public outputs; local values cannot be summed as full-sequence HOTA.

controller_training_gate.failure: FAIL_INTERVENTION_SUPERVISION_IDENTIFIABILITY; learned controller NOT_RUN, retain other branches and diagnostics.

learned_model_budget: <50000 parameters; MLP capacity matched to structured heads; runtime features explicit allowlist only, no sequence/GT/future-value inputs.
structured_model: Separate target/future-continuity, competitor-damage and memory-risk heads supervised with actual raw counterfactual components, plus causal regret/temporal reliability aggregation; not a generic MLP followed by a renamed sigmoid.

training.class_balance: Natural inverse-frequency weights; no artificial positive copies.

bonus_reliability: Separate fit-only GT-labeled native and positive correctness probabilities in [0,1]; keep original hard negatives; identity-conditioned discounts require causal initialized identity evidence.

memory_protocol.P1_P2: Exact original R4 policies/calibration as reproduction controls.
memory_protocol.P3: Same native scope/tid for 2 or 3 consecutive assigned observations; identity top-1 agrees; require causal anchor/state/motion/quality reliability.
memory_protocol.P4: Pending observations only; confirmation/write occurs on the later arriving frame; no backdated update or future GT.
memory_protocol.P5: Fit-only write-safety classifier with identity/margin, anchor/state agreement, motion, quality, native continuity and temporal consistency; probability threshold grid on inner only.
memory_protocol.P6: Trust snapshots at causal accepted confirmations; rollback when >=3 consecutive assigned identity top-1/anchor/native contradictions are observed, no future GT. Preserve immutable anchor and monotonic observed frame; diagnostic is not retroactive correction.
memory_protocol.correct_retention_denominator: eligible assigned correct observations on the same policy trajectory
memory_protocol.pareto: Inner-only grid frontier; formal selected thresholds frozen before outer. Do not tune a new threshold on outer curves.

inner_selection: Same proposals across controller comparisons. Choose full-sequence HOTA subject to DetA>=baseline-0.005; then AssA, IDSW, safe-memory tradeoff, complexity with KEEP favored at equality. Freeze every outer configuration before its metrics. Limited shortlist selection uses only fit counterfactual validity and inner data, not outer performance.

uncertainty.estimator: sequence-macro delta CI, official combined TrackEval delta reported separately

val_rule: NOT_RUN unless strict DEV gate passes and final train-side policy is frozen; historically exposed VAL is not virgin data. No TEST.

resources.storage_strategy: Stream compressed own-stage traces/value audits; temporary MOT files under mktemp for official evaluator, remove only own verified regenerable temporary files. Never modify/delete R4/historical data.
